newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks end down ahead of protest strike.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks end down ahead of protest strike.

text.p: Pakistani stocks close lower on Monday ahaead of a strike on Tuesday called by a militant Sunni Moslem faction to protest at the killing of its leader in a bomb blast on Saturday, dealers said.
They said the market was likely to open mixed to weak as most investors remained on sidelines or operated cautiously amid fear of violence during the strike.

The Karachi Stock Exchange 100-share index fell 8.19 points, or 0.57 percent, to end at 1,432.57. Losers led gainers 101 to 76. Turnover rose to 24 million shares from 22 million in the previous session.

Askari Bank rose 0.55 rupees to 26.40 rupees. Dewan Salman Fibre fell 0.15 to 31.90. D.G. Khan Cement fell 0.20 to 10.30. Hub Power Co fell 0.65 to 36.35 and Pakistan State Oil 2.0 to 284. PTCL fell 0.35 to 28.20. Fauji Fertilizer rose 0.25 to 72.75 but ICI Pakistan fell 0.10 to 18.10.
